My crown came loose, so I consulted a dentist here for root canal treatment and a new post. The dentist said there was a 70% chance the root would break during drilling, but we agreed, thinking we'd be part of that 30% chance of success. However, during the consultation, the dentist seemed unsure if they could do it, and the assistant kept giving the dentist advice – honestly, it was as if the assistant knew more than the dentist. As expected, the root broke, turning what should have been just a root canal treatment and a new post costing under 10,000 baht into a need for an implant, likely costing around 60,000 baht in total. Because of this experience, I no longer trust this clinic and went to another. The new dentist said the previous dentist had messed things up. Honestly, if the dentist thought they couldn't do it, they should have told the patient, suggested other, more skilled dentists, or something, instead of taking the risk. Overall, it was a stroke of bad luck. The dentist scheduled a second appointment, but I won't be going back because I no longer trust this clinic, and the assistant's attitude was quite poor. After the X-ray was finished, instead of holding the door open for me a little, they let it spring open and almost hit me in the face. Overall, I really made a mistake coming here.
